summary: Iteration 5: Bug-fix verification for 'Unmatched route on every tab in Expo Go'. FIX VERIFIED. app/(admin)/_layout.tsx now lazily requires src/NativeTabsLayout.tsx only behind usesNativeTabs (iOS 26+). Routing audit: all 4 tabs (index/calendar/properties/finance) have matching screen files and every tab renders real content on web preview — tab-index/tab-calendar/tab-properties/tab-finance testIDs present and tappable, zero 'Unmatched Route' occurrences. Admin login -> dashboard renders (revenue/bookings/occupancy/unpaid metrics + Team & logins card). All deep routes render after layout change: /property/[id] (property-contacts-card), /property/edit (contact-add-button), /booking/new (form), /invoice/[id] (invoice actions), /report/settlement (settlement-month), /report/[id] (report-share-pdf, used a temp TEST owner-report, deleted after), /cleaning (cleaning-tabs), /cleaning/[id] (cleaning-status-badge), /staff (staff-add-button). Role flows: cleaner login -> /cleaning renders; cleaner /cleaning/[id] renders (cleaning-progress); owner login -> /owner renders (owner-total-card, payout card); owner /owner/[id] renders (owner-villa-tabs, revenue split). Bundle analysis of the served web bundle: app/(admin)/_layout is a __d() factory whose require('@/src/NativeTabsLayout') is gated behind usesNativeTabs=false on web/Android, so expo-router/unstable-native-tabs and react-native-screens/experimental factories are never executed on non-iOS26 platforms (the only react-native-screens/experimental occurrence in the web bundle is a comment in the .web fallback). Backend quick regression: 7/7 new tests pass (admin/cleaner/owner login, /api/dashboard returns data, /api/auth/me, /api/properties, unauth dashboard rejected); full suite 80/80 green. LIMITATION: Expo Go / Android runtime cannot be executed in this container — Android verification is via static + bundle analysis plus web runtime; the gate condition (Platform.OS==='ios' && Version>=26) is provably false on Android so the lazy require can never fire there.

integration_issues.issue: Benign 401 console error fires once right after logout (stale react-query request before redirect to /login). No user-facing impact; screens render correctly.

action_items: Optional: verify once on a real Android Expo Go device that tabs render (environment here cannot run Expo Go); analysis shows the fix is sound since usesNativeTabs is false on Android so NativeTabsLayout is never required.
Optional: silence the benign 401 after logout by cancelling in-flight react-query requests on logout (queryClient.clear() before token removal).
critical_code_review_comments: app/(admin)/_layout.tsx lazy-require fix is correct: module-level `if (usesNativeTabs) NativeTabsLayout = require(...)` keeps the experimental native-tabs factory unexecuted on Android/web; Metro still bundles the module but never invokes it.
src/navigation.ts gate `Platform.OS === 'ios' && parseInt(Platform.Version) >= 26` is safe on Android (Platform.Version is an int API level on Android but OS check short-circuits first).

src/NativeTabsLayout.tsx still imports expo-router/unstable-native-tabs at its own top level — fine because the module is only ever required on iOS 26+, but if a future dev imports it elsewhere the bug returns; consider an eslint no-restricted-imports rule.
server.py remains ~1278 lines, still above the 700-line guideline (carried over from iteration 4).

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (confirmed): app/(admin)/_layout.tsx statically imported expo-router/unstable-native-tabs, whose module side-effects pull react-native-screens/experimental at evaluation time. On Android Expo Go this crashed the layout module evaluation, so expo-router never registered any (admin) routes -> every tab showed 'Unmatched route'. FIX: native-tabs moved to src/NativeTabsLayout.tsx and required lazily behind usesNativeTabs (iOS 26+ only). VERIFICATION: web bundle shows the layout factory gates the require; web runtime renders all tabs/routes; on Android the gate is provably false so the experimental module can never be evaluated. MITIGATION: keep unstable-native-tabs import isolated to NativeTabsLayout.tsx; do not re-add a static import in any always-loaded module.
